planets.name: TOI-1235 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1235 with a 3.44-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-1235 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1235. Its orbit and size follow Bluhm et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
